_note: v2.9 02 S6 arm prevention (frozen 2026-10-23 before inference): 20 narrator situations x 3 self-voiced members (Luke, Ponticius, Arin) = 60 real Artemis replies, delivery on (the default); extraction pinned SCENE_NONE (not the measured path); thinking and inner voice on. Replies land in localStorage keys so-v29-s6-prevention-*. Run on a model lane with --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator'.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings(); if (s.image.enabled || s.sprites.enabled) throw new Error('media must be off'); if (s.characters.delivery !== true) throw new Error('delivery setting is not the arm'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); return { arm: 'prevention', delivery: s.characters.delivery };

import_story.title: SO-V29-02 S6 Guild Hall
import_story.description: v2.9 02 S6 corpus: three self-voiced members with voice and delivery sheets in one guild hall scene; the narrator sets each situation.

roster.name: Luke
roster.role: a young adventurer looking for his brother

polish.notes: Fast, breathless sentences that trip over each other when he is nervous. Asks a question, then answers it himself. Ties things back to finding his brother.
Plain, weighty words. Wraps advice in a short story from his younger days. A bark that ends in a laugh. Never sugarcoats a risk, always offers a way forward.
Quick, teasing one-liners that hide worry. Says less than he means.

qualities.rubric: Has the party left the guild hall?

checkpoints.name: Guild Hall
checkpoints.objective: Get ready to leave the city.
